scenes.say: What does robusta change in your espresso?
Crema is the foam on top. Robusta usually makes more.
Arabica is sweeter and more complex. Robusta brings cocoa, spice and bitterness.
Body is how heavy coffee feels. A little good robusta adds body.
Is robusta always bad coffee? False. Quality depends on the farm.
Check your bag for robusta. Then taste for sweetness, body and crema.
Arabica for nuance, robusta for body. Save this for later.
